review_scope: Approve only the methods and additional TC test authoring described by this exact plan. This does not approve execution, exact ledger/contract/runner, source correctness, any test result, H2 acceptance, or original AT acceptance.

findings.subject: NEG-WINDOW equality-clock seam
findings.initial_v1_issue: The initial plan did not explicitly require before/while/after checks of function OID, owner, ACL, SECURITY DEFINER, complete proconfig/search_path, and the exact one-assignment diff/restore.
findings.v2_resolution: The reviewed v2 requires those identity/security metadata oracles before, during, and after replacement; byte-exact restore; a live claim at the frozen instant; and abort on any unmet invariant. It also keeps actual-clock before/after cases separate, limits replacement to one assignment in a dedicated synthetic database, prohibits trigger disable and production clock switches, and requires both independent and TC acceptance before authoring this fixture exception.
findings.assessment: Resolved in the exact reviewed v2 plan. The seam remains synthetic equality-boundary evidence only and cannot substitute for actual unmodified-runtime before/after tests.

crash_barriers: The 12 named crash obligations cover all ten implementation-contract barriers: API commit/response; claim commit/Temporal RPC; accepted Start/lost response; Start response/admission; admission/ack; ack/worker activation; projection/pre-PG-commit; projection PG commit/activity-history result; activity result/next workflow decision; and independent PostgreSQL/Temporal restart.
Two additional obligations separately exercise two-live-dispatcher stale fencing and admitted-history deletion fail-closed behavior.
completeness_findings.negative_obligations: The 13 distinct NEG obligations cover startup authority/configuration, machine-authority race, Started-input validation, foreign deployment, READY workspace identity, current human authority, SQL/role/projection fences, pre-admission activity, finite start window and retention, retention RPC uncertainty, non-create notification, runtime fatal-stop behavior, and hung-driver bounded shutdown.
completeness_findings.regression_and_scope: The plan requires a fresh rerun of all 407 retained normal/H1/SQL-local cases, preserves original17 design contracts and two uploads, calls for affected G1-G5/H1 regression, and explicitly leaves H6 and H3-H7/original32 AT incomplete.

privacy_and_execution_controls.interpretation: This approval permits additional TC authoring only. New literal IDs, expected before/cut/after states, and source pins still require exact ledger/contract review; execution requires independently reviewed runner and frozen pre-gate.

remaining_limits: The crash and negative cases are pending; this approval is not evidence that any oracle works or passes.
The NEG-WINDOW equality seam still requires exact fixture implementation review and proof of all stated invariants before use.
Full H2, H6, original AT, and broader AX acceptance remain incomplete.
